description: Retrieve output from a running background shell session by session_id. Set 'all' to false to read only output produced since the last read (incremental). Optionally provide 'filter' (a regex) to keep only matching lines; an invalid regex is ignored.
name: shell_output

all.description: Return the full output buffer (default true); false returns only new output since the last read

filter.description: Regex; only matching lines are returned (invalid regexes are ignored)

max_bytes.description: Cap the returned window at this many bytes; positions stay valid across ring truncation

session_id.description: The session ID returned by backend_shell

start.description: Absolute byte position to read from (a previous windowed response's 'window_end' continues the stream)
